location: Taroko Gorge, Taroko National Park, Hualien
alt: Steep marble walls of Taroko Gorge rising above the Liwu River
caption: Marble walls of Taroko Gorge above the Liwu River. Day 3 is built around the fixed time windows when Highway 8 opens, so the group walks and photographs the gorge in a short, planned slot.

alt: Sheer coastal cliffs of Qingshui falling into the Pacific Ocean
caption: Qingshui Cliff, where the mountains drop almost vertically into the Pacific on the Hualien coast. It is the first coastal viewpoint on Day 3, after the gorge, and shows the scale of the east coast road.

alt: Rice paddies in Chishang with the Coastal Mountain Range behind
caption: Rice paddies at Chishang in the East Rift Valley, with the Coastal Range behind. Days 4 and 5 cycle between these fields and pitch tents at a licensed campsite nearby.

commonsFile: File:三地門鄉原住民文化館124.jpg
alt: Paiwan and Rukai cultural hall building in Sandimen township
caption: The Sandimen indigenous cultural hall, a former Japanese-era shrine now showing Paiwan art and craft. It anchors Day 7, when the group meets carvers and bead makers who sell directly.

alt: Chihkan Tower lit at night in Tainan
caption: Chihkan Tower lit at night, built on the site of the Dutch Fort Provintia. It is the centre of the Day 9 walk through Tainan's four centuries of Dutch, Ming-loyalist and Qing history.

location: Zhaoping Station, Alishan Forest Railway, Chiayi County
alt: Narrow-gauge Alishan Forest Railway station and train among mountain forest
caption: Zhaoping Station on the narrow-gauge Alishan Forest Railway, which climbs through cypress forest to 2,200 m. Day 10 rides this line to reach the cloud forest.

alt: Sunrise light through trees and cloud above the Alishan ridges
caption: Sunrise over the Alishan ridges as seen from the Zhushan station area. The pre-dawn train on Day 11 is timed for this view, which depends on clear mornings.

alt: Japanese-era Beitou Hot Spring Museum building in Taipei
caption: The Beitou Hot Spring Museum, a former public bathhouse from the Japanese period. It offers a last onsen stop in Taipei on Day 11 before the closing temple visits and the flight.

alt: Interior of Mengjia Longshan Temple in Taipei
caption: Inside Mengjia Longshan Temple, an active Taipei temple where worshippers burn incense daily. It is the main stop of the Day 12 temple morning before the evening flight.

commonsFile: File:Sanxiantai Eight-arch Bridge under blue sky with clouds on 14 May 2016.jpg
alt: Sanxiantai Eight-arch Bridge on the Taitung coast under a blue sky
caption: The Eight-arch Bridge at Sanxiantai, a walkway over the sea on the Taitung coast. It is the stop on Day 6 where the Coastal Range crossing meets the Highway 11 Pacific road.

commonsFile: File:Xiangde temple on Nine Lotus Mountain, Tianxiang, Taroko Gorge (12609308644).jpg
location: Xiangde Temple, Tianxiang, Taroko National Park
alt: Xiangde Temple on the forested slope above Tianxiang in Taroko Gorge
caption: Xiangde Temple on the forested slope above Tianxiang. Its trail is one of the open routes used during the Day 3 gorge window, alongside the Tianxiang paths.

alt: Shennong Street in Tainan's historic centre
caption: Shennong Street, a restored historic lane in Tainan's old centre. The group walks it on Day 9 between the forts, temples and street-food stalls.
